rows.quote: Protein data were sourced from 2 large cohorts: UKB-PPP (the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project), where proteins were measured using the Olink platform in 54 219 individuals, and deCODE, where proteins were measured using the SomaScan platform in 35 559 individuals.
rows.coder_note: Reread: sentence gives deCODE proteins measured on the SomaScan platform in 35 559 individuals; that exact N with that platform is the N and platform of one dictionary row only (the other deCODE row has a different N).
